cells.label: Contractual maturity of assets / Total

citations.clause: SARB PA Directive D5/2025 §2.1.11 (form BA 300, Annexure 10A/10B) read with the Regulations relating to Banks reg 26 (liquidity risk / minimum liquid assets and the liquidity coverage ratio) and the Basel III LCR (BCBS D295) and NSFR (BCBS D335) standards; Banks Act 94 of 1990 s.6(6)(a). [Post-#1451 corrected row (D-BA-RETURN-NUMBERING-EXCEL-CANONICAL): per the canonical SARB Excel form schedule, form BA 300 is the LIQUIDITY RISK return (incl. the LCR and the NSFR series); the verbatim §2.1.11 'operational risk' annotation in the obligation record is the documented fabrication the correction supersedes — operational risk is BA 400.]

dataRequirements.description: Contractual maturity of assets / Total: aggregated from constituent cells via the ba300-liquidity-risk-fold projection (calculation: [BA300,R0020,C0010]+[BA300,R0030,C0010]+[BA300,R0040,C0010]).

cells.statusReason: Liquidity-risk figures fold from the BA-300 LCR / NSFR projections over the cash-flow events plus the HQLA stock fold over SecurityMaster. The HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts), the HQLA stock fold (platform/reporting/hqla-stock.ts) and the BA-300 LCR fold (platform/reporting/ba-300-lcr.ts) exist as substrate; the deposit-funding / NSFR cells require real deposit and funding positions which the bank-in-formation does not book pre-licence-day, so those values are licence-day data. The product-attribute dataRequirements — deposit funding-stability / category / maturity, HQLA asset level / eligibility / haircut — bind now so a future deposit / HQLA-eligible product is correctly gated. No silent fabrication.

[Post-#1451 corrected row (D-BA-RETURN-NUMBERING-EXCEL-CANONICAL): per the canonical SARB Excel form schedule, form BA 300 is the LIQUIDITY RISK return (incl. the LCR and the NSFR series); the verbatim §2.1.11 'operational risk' annotation in the obligation record is the documented fabrication the correction supersedes — operational risk is BA 400.]

derivation.expression: ba300-liquidity-risk-fold for line R0060, More than 4 years to 5 years dimension

dataRequirements.description: The ba300-liquidity-risk-fold supplies the More than 4 years to 5 years value for Stable deposits / More than 4 years to 5 years.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Stable deposits / More than 4 years to 5 years aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Stable deposits / More than 4 years to 5 years must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Stable deposits / More than 4 years to 5 years must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Stable deposits / More than 4 years to 5 years must carry its maturityCallability: the residual maturity / notice period / callability of the deposit or funding — whether it falls within the 30-day LCR horizon and which NSFR maturity bucket (<6m / 6m–1y / ≥1y) it occupies. Drives both the LCR outflow inclusion and the NSFR ASF factor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54; NSFR BCBS D335 §17–§24; SARB reg 26.)

cells.statusReason: Liquidity-risk figures fold from the BA-300 LCR / NSFR projections over the cash-flow events plus the HQLA stock fold over SecurityMaster. The product-attribute dataRequirements — deposit funding-stability / category / maturity, HQLA asset level / eligibility / haircut — bind now so a future deposit / HQLA-eligible product is correctly gated. citations.clause: SARB PA Directive D5/2025 §2.1.11 (form BA 300, Annexure 10A/10B) read with the Regulations relating to Banks reg 26 (liquidity risk / minimum liquid assets and the liquidity coverage ratio) and the Basel III LCR (BCBS D295) and NSFR (BCBS D335) standards; Banks Act 94 of 1990 s.6(6)(a). [Post-#1451 corrected row (D-BA-RETURN-NUMBERING-EXCEL-CANONICAL): per the canonical SARB Excel form schedule, form BA 300 is the LIQUIDITY RISK return (incl. the LCR and the NSFR series); the verbatim §2.1.11 'operational risk' annotation in the obligation record is the documented fabrication the correction supersedes — operational risk is BA 400.]

derivation.expression: ba300-liquidity-risk-fold for line R0070, More than 3 months to 6 months dimension

dataRequirements.description: The ba300-liquidity-risk-fold supplies the More than 3 months to 6 months value for Volatile deposits / More than 3 months to 6 months.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Volatile deposits / More than 3 months to 6 months aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Volatile deposits / More than 3 months to 6 months must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Volatile deposits / More than 3 months to 6 months must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Volatile deposits / More than 3 months to 6 months must carry its maturityCallability: the residual maturity / notice period / callability of the deposit or funding — whether it falls within the 30-day LCR horizon and which NSFR maturity bucket (<6m / 6m–1y / ≥1y) it occupies. Drives both the LCR outflow inclusion and the NSFR ASF factor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54; NSFR BCBS D335 §17–§24; SARB reg 26.)

cells.statusReason: Liquidity-risk figures fold from the BA-300 LCR / NSFR projections over the cash-flow events plus the HQLA stock fold over SecurityMaster. The HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts), the HQLA stock fold (platform/reporting/hqla-stock.ts) and the BA-300 LCR fold (platform/reporting/ba-300-lcr.ts) exist as substrate; the deposit-funding / NSFR cells require real deposit and funding positions which the bank-in-formation does not book pre-licence-day, so those values are licence-day data. The product-attribute dataRequirements — deposit funding-stability / category / maturity, HQLA asset level / eligibility / haircut — bind now so a future deposit / HQLA-eligible product is correctly gated. No silent fabrication.

derivation.expression: ba300-liquidity-risk-fold for line R0400, Total dimension

dataRequirements.description: The ba300-liquidity-risk-fold supplies the Total value for Stable deposits / Total.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Stable deposits / Total aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Stable deposits / Total must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Stable deposits / Total must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

derivation.expression: ba300-liquidity-risk-fold for line R0600, Total dimension

dataRequirements.description: The ba300-liquidity-risk-fold supplies the Total value for 25% of liquid assets held / Total.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances 25% of liquid assets held / Total aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding 25% of liquid assets held / Total must carry its hqlaEligibility: whether the asset meets the HQLA operational + eligibility criteria (unencumbered, central-bank-eligible, marketable in a deep liquid market) to count as a high-quality liquid asset at all. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §28–§47; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding 25% of liquid assets held / Total must carry its hqlaLevel: the HQLA level of the asset — Level 1, Level 2A or Level 2B — which determines its inclusion in the LCR numerator and the BA 310 liquid-asset stock, and the Level-2 caps (40% / 15%). Computed by the HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts) from the asset descriptor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §24–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding 25% of liquid assets held / Total must carry its hqlaHaircut: the regulatory haircut applied to the asset's market value in the HQLA stock (0% Level 1, 15% Level 2A, 25–50% Level 2B). Computed by the HQLA classifier from the asset's level. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §49–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

dataRequirements.description: ZAR funding position of FX exposures / Total: aggregated from constituent cells via the ba300-liquidity-risk-fold projection (calculation: [BA300,R0750,C0010]-[BA300,R0810,C0010]).

A liquidity-relevant product feeding ZAR funding position of FX exposures / Total must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding ZAR funding position of FX exposures / Total must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

Computed by the HQLA classifier from the asset's level. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §49–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

dataRequirements.description: The ba300-liquidity-risk-fold supplies the Total value for Term deposits with residual maturity greater than 30 days subject to withdrawal with a significant penalty, or no legal right to withdraw / Total.

GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Term deposits with residual maturity greater than 30 days subject to withdrawal with a significant penalty, or no legal right to withdraw / Total aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Term deposits with residual maturity greater than 30 days subject to withdrawal with a significant penalty, or no legal right to withdraw / Total must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Term deposits with residual maturity greater than 30 days subject to withdrawal with a significant penalty, or no legal right to withdraw / Total must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Term deposits with residual maturity greater than 30 days subject to withdrawal with a significant penalty, or no legal right to withdraw / Total must carry its maturityCallability: the residual maturity / notice period / callability of the deposit or funding — whether it falls within the 30-day LCR horizon and which NSFR maturity bucket (<6m / 6m–1y / ≥1y) it occupies. Drives both the LCR outflow inclusion and the NSFR ASF factor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54; NSFR BCBS D335 §17–§24; SARB reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Secured funding backed by qualifying level 2B high-quality liquid assets other than level 2B high-quality liquid assets already specified hereinbefore / Total must carry its hqlaEligibility: whether the asset meets the HQLA operational + eligibility criteria (unencumbered, central-bank-eligible, marketable in a deep liquid market) to count as a high-quality liquid asset at all. A liquidity-relevant product feeding Secured funding backed by qualifying level 2B high-quality liquid assets other than level 2B high-quality liquid assets already specified hereinbefore / Total must carry its hqlaLevel: the HQLA level of the asset — Level 1, Level 2A or Level 2B — which determines its inclusion in the LCR numerator and the BA 310 liquid-asset stock, and the Level-2 caps (40% / 15%). Computed by the HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts) from the asset descriptor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §24–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Secured funding backed by qualifying level 2B high-quality liquid assets other than level 2B high-quality liquid assets already specified hereinbefore / Total must carry its hqlaHaircut: the regulatory haircut applied to the asset's market value in the HQLA stock (0% Level 1, 15% Level 2A, 25–50% Level 2B). (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §28–§47; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding - level one high-quality liquid assets as collateral / Total must carry its hqlaHaircut: the regulatory haircut applied to the asset's market value in the HQLA stock (0% Level 1, 15% Level 2A, 25–50% Level 2B). Computed by the HQLA classifier from the asset's level. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §49–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances "Stable" demand and/or term deposits from retail and small business customers / Total.  < 6 months aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding "Stable" demand and/or term deposits from retail and small business customers / Total.  < 6 months must carry its fundingStability: whether the deposit is a 'stable' or 'less stable' deposit, which selects the LCR run-off rate (stable retail 3–5%, less-stable retail 10%+) and the NSFR available-stable-funding factor. The defining attribute of the LCR retail / small-business deposit rows. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §54–§84; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§24; SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 26.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding "Stable" demand and/or term deposits from retail and small business customers / Total.  < 6 months must carry its depositCounterpartyCategory: the LCR/NSFR counterparty category of the funding provider — retail / small business vs wholesale non-financial corporate vs financial institution vs sovereign/PSE — which selects the outflow / ASF weighting band. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §90–§111; NSFR BCBS D335 §22–§40; SARB reg 26.)

dataRequirements.description: Securities eligible as Level 1 HQLA / Total.  < 6 months: aggregated from constituent cells via the ba300-liquidity-risk-fold projection (calculation: [BA300,R2340,C0010]+[BA300,R2350,C0010]).

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Securities eligible as Level 1 HQLA / Total.  < 6 months must carry its hqlaLevel: the HQLA level of the asset — Level 1, Level 2A or Level 2B — which determines its inclusion in the LCR numerator and the BA 310 liquid-asset stock, and the Level-2 caps (40% / 15%). Computed by the HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts) from the asset descriptor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §24–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Securities eligible as Level 1 HQLA / Total.  < 6 months must carry its hqlaEligibility: whether the asset meets the HQLA operational + eligibility criteria (unencumbered, central-bank-eligible, marketable in a deep liquid market) to count as a high-quality liquid asset at all. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §28–§47; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Securities eligible as Level 1 HQLA / Total.  < 6 months must carry its hqlaHaircut: the regulatory haircut applied to the asset's market value in the HQLA stock (0% Level 1, 15% Level 2A, 25–50% Level 2B). Computed by the HQLA classifier from the asset's level. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §49–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

dataRequirements.description:
Liquidity coverage ratio (LCR):
Total level 2A HQLA - Other Qualifying Items: a text reporting input (identifier / classification / response) captured at report-generation time.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Liquidity coverage ratio (LCR):
Total level 2A HQLA - Other Qualifying Items must carry its hqlaLevel: the HQLA level of the asset — Level 1, Level 2A or Level 2B — which determines its inclusion in the LCR numerator and the BA 310 liquid-asset stock, and the Level-2 caps (40% / 15%). Computed by the HQLA classifier (platform/collateral/hqla-classifier.ts) from the asset descriptor. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §24–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Liquidity coverage ratio (LCR):
Total level 2A HQLA - Other Qualifying Items must carry its hqlaEligibility: whether the asset meets the HQLA operational + eligibility criteria (unencumbered, central-bank-eligible, marketable in a deep liquid market) to count as a high-quality liquid asset at all. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §28–§47; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Liquidity coverage ratio (LCR):
Total level 2A HQLA - Other Qualifying Items must carry its hqlaHaircut: the regulatory haircut applied to the asset's market value in the HQLA stock (0% Level 1, 15% Level 2A, 25–50% Level 2B). Computed by the HQLA classifier from the asset's level. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §49–§54; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)
